bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src=f173f8e86d1abb0eb105251261cfc0b31dc2f954
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-f173f8e-20261115"
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 61
else
 git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
 test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 63
 git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 64
fi
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 65
grep -q 'MENU_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID' "$stage/artifacts/bot/scripts/publishMenuPanels.ts" || exit 66
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-f173f8e "$stage" >/tmp/gace-menu-f173-build.log 2>&1 || exit 67
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-f173f8e --check /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 68
